name: I Guarantee It
aka: You're Going To Like The Way You Look
look: Still from a TV commercial: Men's Wearhouse founder George Zimmer, a gray-haired man with a full white beard in a dark suit, smiles warmly as he speaks toward the camera. A bright window and a blurred figure are behind him.
use: Echoes his ad slogan "You're going to like the way you look. I guarantee it." The top text makes a confident promise, often a sarcastic or obviously false one, and the bottom says "I guarantee it."
examples: You're going to like the way this pizza tastes at 3 a.m.
You're going to regret that last text to the group chat
describe: old man with a white beard smiling in a suit commercial
bearded guy from the suit store ads
suit company founder promising you will like how you look
gray bearded businessman smiling warmly at the camera
mens clothing tv ad guy making a promise
origin: Men's Wearhouse founder George Zimmer in one of the chain's TV ads, which ended with his line "I guarantee it."
